digest.component_or_area: Plan-review prompt caching and Pass-1/Pass-2 verifier system prompt alignment
propositions: Pass-1 finder and both Pass-2 verifier prompts must share a byte-identical plan-bearing prefix to enable Anthropic provider-side cache prefix reuse within the 5-minute ephemeral TTL.
The shared prefix is single-sourced in prompts.py as SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + shared_plan_prefix() to enforce structural invariant and prevent drift across template renderers.

An exhaustiveness directive ('enumerate EVERY independent defect') is added as a new bullet to SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE and reaches every Pass-1 entry point (finder, container, ISF) and the verifier prefix by byte-identity.
Plan-review verifier templates are restructured: both begin with {{shared_prefix}}, drop {{plan}} and the volatile marker, leaving finding listings in user-turn via base_instructions→instructions.
The Pass-1 warm gate measurement changes from est_tokens(plan) to est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(plan)) to match the actual cached bytes, ensuring boundary correctness.

Byte-identity is enforced via code control flow: plan_review_verify_inputs emits shared_prefix (not plan), both yaml verify with: blocks wire shared_prefix, and renderers supply the prefix variable through the existing generic mechanism.
